subject: general
question: Refraction of light, as it enters from one transparent medium to another, is due to

options.text: change in temperature of the media
change in the amplitude of light

solution: __**Explanation:**__ Refraction: • When a ray of light passes from one medium to another it suffers a change in direction at the boundary of two media is called refraction. • The change in direction because the speed of light travels at different speeds in different mediums. The Refractive Index of a medium defines that it is denser or rarer
